what_happened: G6-E1 T3 failed with 'assert e[total_ms] > 0'. On Windows, time.time() granularity is 15.625 ms (GetSystemTimeAsFileTime); the warm, stubbed T3 search path completes in ~4.9 ms, so total_ms rounded to 0.
root_cause: Test asserted strictly positive wall-clock milliseconds on a path that can complete below the OS timer granularity. Environmental (Windows), not a product defect.
what_i_did_wrong: Test was written assuming sub-millisecond clock resolution. Fixed test-only: the T3 search stub is wrapped with time.sleep(0.05) so elapsed time necessarily exceeds timer granularity; assertions unchanged.
action_taken: Test-only sleep added to verify_g6_e1.py T3 stub (t3_search); E1 suite green T1-T10 + parity + acceptance 9/9 + 0/10. No product change.
